description: Search the Classification of Instructional Programs (CIP) taxonomy by keyword or partial name. Returns matching CIP codes with standard titles. Use this before passing cip_code filters to scorecard_search_programs or scorecard_get_programs when you know a program by name but not its code. Served entirely from embedded static data — no API call, no rate limit impact.

limit.description: Requested limit; serving cap 50, hard ceiling 1,000.

query.description: Search term — program name keyword (e.g. "computer science", "nursing", "business"). Matches against CIP titles and family names.

name: scorecard_lookup_cip

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

guidance.description: Concrete narrowing guidance when matches remain.

results.description: Matching CIP entries ranked by relevance.

truncated.description: True when results were capped at the limit.

title: Lookup CIP Code
